events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on August 15, 1969, in Bethel, New York, drawing hundreds of thousands for '3 Days of Peace & Music'.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibes
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Woodstock Festival, which kicked off on this day in '69. It was more than just music; it was a movement. What's your favourite memory or track from the era?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: August 16th marks the anniversary of the death of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away in 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: On this day, we pay tribute to the one and only King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley. His music continues to move generations. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: The influential American rapper and actor Tupac Shakur died on September 13, 1996, six days after being shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact of Tupac Shakur, who passed away on this day in '96. His powerful lyrics and artistry continue to resonate. What's his most iconic track for you?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: September 18th marks the anniversary of the death of legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away in London in 1970 at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix. His revolutionary guitar work changed music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix moment or riff?

events.title: Abbey Road Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Abbey Road' was released on September 26, 1969, featuring its legendary zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road Memories
angles.copy: Celebrating the anniversary of The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' album. That cover, those tracks... pure timeless genius. Which song is on repeat for you?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the enduring frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! A true rock legend whose voice and attitude continue to inspire. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive voice of Oasis and a British rock icon, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Forever a rock and roll star. What's your top Oasis anthem?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's powerful and timeless album 'Imagine' was released on September 9, 1971, featuring his signature song.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: Celebrating the anniversary of John Lennon's 'Imagine' album. A masterpiece that continues to inspire peace and unity. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: First iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod on October 23, 2001, forever changing how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Today marks the anniversary of the first iPod's launch in 2001. It revolutionised music on the go. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated as James Bond Day, marking the 1962 premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No'.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic theme tunes to unforgettable gadgets, 007 always delivers. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate Bond song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary musician, songwriter, and peace activist John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled genius and vision of John Lennon. His music and message live on. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! A true master of comedy. What's your favourite Monty Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: 'The White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: Celebrating the anniversary of The Beatles' sprawling 'White Album'. A diverse masterpiece that broke new ground. Which track from it stands out for you?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: November 24th marks the anniversary of the death of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Forever
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, his stage presence, his legacy – truly unforgettable. What's your favourite Queen anthem?
